entities.name: Shorikai
entities.description: A kami of Kamigawa bonded with Kotori within the Epoch Engine mech, perceived as having a dark aura and tangled black hair.

entities.name: Kotori
entities.description: The pilot of the Epoch Engine, who bonds with the kami Shorikai.

entities.name: Epoch Engine
entities.description: A mech whose kami is Shorikai.

events.summary: Kotori bonds with Shorikai and the two begin to refer to themselves as Kotori-Shorikai.
events.quote: After bonding with its pilot, the two began to refer to themselves as Kotori-Shorikai.

relations.note: Kotori is the pilot bonded with Shorikai.
relations.quote: Shorikai is the kami within the Epoch Engine.
